amendment: Selected sources expose insufficient untreated pulmonary lesion-size/date crosswalk and extensive prior art. Before numerical computation, freeze the limited validity check below; values were already visible during feasibility and this is explicitly retrospective, not preregistration. No expanded hypothesis or paper candidate follows.
numerical_question: Do all published primary-lesion size intervals in Carroll2025 and all reported irradiated lesion size/SUV pairs in Paoluzzi2018 support an untreated or unconfounded drug/RT response comparator?
choices: Carroll2025 all clinical primary size timepoints and all lung follow-up states; pathology sizes retained separately because specimen vs imaging
Paoluzzi2018 both irradiated lesions, reported longest/second dimensions and SUV, one donor with concurrent pazopanib
Morioka2016 all two EMC rows and all three BSC histology identities; no pairing or efficacy effect calculation across diseases
Brown2020 all three author-labelled EMC donors and observation lengths; Elsayed2018 entire untreated serial lung interval and every five serial figure-date captions
analysis: Percent change=(later-earlier)/earlier*100. For Carroll only Aug2018→Aug2019 derives diameter rate per nominal12months; no volume inference, no RECIST assignment from one lesion, no p-value or pooled prevalence. No personal diagnosis, treatment recommendation or causal conclusion.
defeat: If primary studies already establish indolence/regression and no independent measured comparator supports a new consequential contrast, shelve standalone paper. An arithmetic check remains preserved evidence, not discovery.
